name: zcode-beautify
description: Set an image, video, or Wallpaper Engine scene as the ZCode desktop background, adapt all UI colors with Material Design 3 (Monet) dynamic color, and tune chat layout, bubble styles, and more from a live in-app panel and the in-chat Bubble Studio page. The CDP injection layer is an explicit opt-in experimental capability (disabled by default).

description_i18n.en: Set an image, video, or Wallpaper Engine scene as the ZCode desktop background, adapt all UI colors with Material Design 3 (Monet) dynamic color, and tune chat layout, bubble styles, and more from a live in-app panel and the in-chat Bubble Studio page. The CDP injection layer is an explicit opt-in experimental capability (disabled by default).
description_i18n.zh-CN: 把图片、视频或 Wallpaper Engine 场景设为 ZCode 桌面背景，以 Material Design 3（Monet）动态取色适配全局界面配色，并可在应用内实时面板与对话内「气泡工坊」页面中调节聊天布局、气泡样式等。CDP 注入层为需显式开启的实验性能力（默认关闭）。
